body:
Founder-reported live bug (GitHub issue emilyspringerton/GoblinFoxDragon#33, filed 2026-09-12:
"mobs just sit dead in the mobs table and dont respawn").

Root cause found in code: apps2/mud/main.go's tickAll() respawn path re-inserted a dead mob via
Registry.Spawn(m) using the same mob ID -- but server/mob.Registry.Hit() never removes a dead
mob from its map, it only flips State to StateDead. Spawn() rejects any ID already present
("mob %q already exists"), and the call site swallowed that error (`_ = reg.Spawn(m)`), so every
single respawn attempt silently failed forever -- the dead mob just sat in the table exactly as
reported.

Fix: added Registry.Revive(id, pos) to server/mob/mob.go, which resets an already-registered
mob back to HP=MaxHP/State=Idle/Pos in place (and clears TaggerSlot/AggroSlot/DiedAt/burrow
state so it behaves as a genuinely fresh spawn, not a corpse with its old life's tag still
attached) instead of trying to re-Spawn a duplicate ID. Updated apps2/mud/main.go's deadQueue
processing to call Revive, falling back to Spawn only if the mob is genuinely gone from the
registry (e.g. a zone reset). Added TestReviveBringsDeadMobBack and TestReviveUnknownIDErrors
to server/mob/mob_test.go documenting the original bug and the fix. Full module test suite
(GOWORK=off go test ./...) passes.
